goal: Complete PARITY-006 canonical closure, PARITY-007 independent closeout, and canonical program terminal state.

lanes.A_AUDIT: repository, state, evidence, privacy and reachability audit
lanes.B_HOST: Resolve/Fusion host execution and artifact qualification
lanes.V_FRESH: fresh independent verifier; never repairs own candidate

recovery_routes.wrong_repo: switch to D:\Documents\PSD2Fusion and rerun opening sequence
recovery_routes.local_ref_missing: GitHub API + git ls-remote + explicit refspec fetch; continue if remote resolves
recovery_routes.unrelated_dirty_tree: create fresh worktree at intended exact commit; preserve unrelated work
recovery_routes.main_advanced: fresh compare; non-destructively integrate main; rerun only affected verification; no force rewrite
recovery_routes.gh007: for unpushed commit use established repository noreply author/reset-author without global config change
recovery_routes.single_test_fail: retry once unchanged; if deterministic localize/fix smallest cause and continue
recovery_routes.evidence_missing_reproducible: regenerate from qualified inputs/candidate; record superseding evidence
recovery_routes.resolve_absent: relaunch/reconnect if safe and available; exact project PSD2Fusion; sanity before full
recovery_routes.resolve_crash: record incident; changed diagnostic route after at most one unchanged retry; classify size/node/Saver/range/memory/lifecycle
recovery_routes.artifact_hash_changed: recompute pixel/metadata metrics; hash difference alone is not material failure
recovery_routes.strict_small_quantization_fail: retain diagnostic FAIL; do not repair byte identity
recovery_routes.verifier_evidence_fail: separate Worker repairs evidence/state only; launch new fresh verifier
recovery_routes.verifier_code_fail: separate Worker bounded fix + affected regression; launch new fresh verifier
recovery_routes.verifier_material_fail: localize -> fixture -> hypotheses -> host evidence -> one bounded repair -> full regression -> new fresh verifier
recovery_routes.premerge_guard_fail: expected until canonical main promotion; preserve branch PASS
recovery_routes.postmerge_guard_fail: fresh main/state/evidence read; repair reversible publish/state mismatch; rerun guard

items.action: Fresh-read repo/cwd/main/codex-parity-006/PR6/current state/P6 verifier/evidence using remote API+ls-remote+explicit fetch as needed.
done_when: stale local refs not treated as truth
items.on_fail: apply recovery_routes for repo/ref/remote before any stop code

items.action: Audit P6 verifier linkage and branch drift; prove post-verifier changes are control/evidence-only or re-verify affected production behavior.
items.on_fail: if production drift -> rerun affected verification; if only control/evidence drift -> superseding linkage evidence

items.action: Apply branch-level PARITY-006 done/pass transition and advance P7 to ready only as Goal/schema allow; update evidence linkage; run state/schema validation and check.ps1.
items.on_fail: fix state/schema/check issue if reversible; do not alter production for state-only failure

items.action: Publish P6 branch; fresh readback; verify state, candidate, verifier and evidence reachability; run branch-level guard/result record.
items.on_fail: fresh remote recovery; S-REMOTE only after reasonable push/fetch/readback retries

items.action: Canonical main promotion of P6 only with explicit authority and fresh safe-FF checks; then fresh main readback and canonical remote completion guard.
items.on_fail: if main advanced, use recovery_routes.main_advanced; if guard fails postmerge, use recovery_routes.postmerge_guard_fail

items.action: Create codex/parity-007 from exact canonical main; add P7 RUNBOOK/QUEUE; set branch-level in_progress according to Worker/state rules; open/update Draft PR.
Create fresh clean verification environment/worktree; establish exact versions/state with no stale generated artifact dependency.
Audit P1-P6 state/evidence integrity, commit reachability, contracts, privacy, unsupported/rejected semantics and transition consistency.
done_when: proof chain intact or defects classified
items.on_fail: repair reproducible evidence/linkage if possible; fresh evidence supersedes stale history

items.action: Run full offline regression: check.ps1, all tests/static checks, parser/evaluation/capability/clipping/group/LD/clbl-failclosed/comparator false-PASS coverage.
done_when: offline regression PASS or bounded correction loop triggered
items.on_fail: retry once unchanged; deterministic failure -> bounded fix in separate Worker then rerun affected/full offline checks

items.action: Fresh regenerate real PSD to ignored temp path; record hashes/counts/warnings/tool count/comp hash/float32/forbidden-tool audit.
items.on_fail: historical count/hash mismatch must be explained, never fitted

items.action: Acquire final fresh actual Fusion proof in dedicated project PSD2Fusion using disposable comp and qualified host route; record full host evidence.
items.on_fail: use Resolve recovery playbook; do not repeat identical crashing full route more than once

items.action: Strict threshold-0 final comparison against qualified reference; record dimensions/profile/RGB/alpha/outlier/coherent-region metrics and classify material vs quantization residual.
done_when: no material blocker or correction loop triggered
items.on_fail: localized >8/>32 or alpha difference is material; localize before any repair

items.action: Independent final semantic/capability audit: fail-closed unknown/clbl false, group/clipping/opacity/non-Normal/LD boundaries, capability-lowering gate, float32, no ID special cases.
done_when: semantic/capability closure audit PASS or defect classified

items.action: False-PASS, privacy and complexity audit including stale artifact, wrong alpha/dims/profile/crop/premult/local outlier/threshold relaxation/oracle-SUT coupling/host-load-vs-render risks.
Run fresh independent PARITY-007 verifier returning exactly PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED. Verifier must not repair its own candidate.
items.on_fail: route to C15 using verifier classification; new verifier only after material evidence/candidate change

items.action: Separate Worker classifies verifier finding and applies smallest bounded correction, then launches a new fresh verifier; do not repeat unchanged failure more than once.
done_when: new verifier PASS or genuine stop code
items.on_fail: S-VERIFIER only after available bounded correction routes are exhausted

items.conditional: C14 PASS or later correction-loop fresh PASS
items.action: Fresh-read schema/Goal and apply legal P7 done/pass plus program terminal state; update evidence linkage; state validation/check.ps1.
Publish P7 branch and fresh remote readback of terminal state, verifier and evidence reachability.
Canonical final main promotion only with explicit authority and fresh safe-FF checks; no force/rewrite/delete; fresh main readback afterward.
items.on_fail: if main advanced, integrate non-destructively and rerun affected proof; then re-evaluate FF

items.action: Run final remote completion guard plus final check.ps1/clean/privacy confirmation from canonical main.
items.on_fail: fresh main/state/evidence read; repair reversible publish/state mismatch; rerun guard before S-REMOTE

items.action: Report PROGRAM DONE only if canonical main proves required P1-P7 done/pass, legal terminal state, final fresh verifier PASS, final fresh Fusion proof, accepted reference comparison, no material/false-PASS blocker, remote guard PASS and no private leakage.

checkpoint_when: a genuine stop code requires human action
unexpected material production defect is found during P7 and product-level judgment is required
